titulek: Parliament, Government set key bills needed for Ukraine’s funding
shrnuti: The Verkhovna Rada and the Cabinet of Ministers have agreed on legislative priorities ahead of the parliamentary plenary week, including bills needed to fulfill Ukraine’s international commitments and secure financial support from partners.
